payload.title: One ordering rule for every list, including Articles and Posts sections
payload.description:
What: Articles and Posts sections are placed by most recent update today while Videos and Findings are placed by best item. Adopt the core rule (rolling seven-day buckets, quality within a bucket, most recent on ties; sections placed by best item) for every list. Depends on Papyrus PPY-196189 and PPY-2d9715.
Acceptance:
Scenario: Articles and Videos sections follow one placement rule
  Given the same item data for both kinds
  When each list is built
  Then a section with a strong recent item comes before a section that was only edited recently
